statements.impact_statement: Trivy 0.67.2 reports no vulnerable mcp in this image; the runtime carries mcp 1.30.0, the first fixed release of the line the previous candidate image reported as 1.28.1.
statements.action_statement: Reassess if the locked mcp dependency changes or if the image is rebuilt from a different source revision. This statement is a technical assessment, not a waiver and not an operator approval.
